title: Belgium Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Belgium study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Belgium study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: University admission; Proof of funds; Health insurance; Passport and forms. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Belgium from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Belgium is generally mid-to-high cost. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Belgium study visa?
faqs.answer: Depends on language of instruction (English / French / Dutch).

faqs.question: Can I study in Belgium with low marks?
faqs.answer: Case by case by university type.

faqs.question: How long does Belgium student visa take from Pakistan?
What documents are needed for Belgium student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport; Acceptance; Funds; Insurance; Academics; Housing.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Belgium?
faqs.answer: Limited student work may be possible under residence rules.

faqs.question: How to apply for Belgium study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Belgium study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Belgium student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

Belgium study visa from Pakistan

Belgium suits EU-focused students targeting Brussels institutions and regional universities. Files need admission, funds and clear study purpose — Belgian missions decide.

Requirements (verify live list)

  • Admission / enrolment from recognized institution
  • Proof of means and accommodation
  • Language evidence per programme
  • Medical insurance meeting stated rules

Refusal risks

  • Weak academic progression story
  • Unexplained sponsor transfers
  • Incomplete translations
